hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: We want to find a subset of numbers whose bitwise exclusive-or equals target, maximizing subset size.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Let dp[val] store the maximum number of elements retained that produce exclusive-or equal to val.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: The minimum removals is then total elements minus the maximum size achieving target.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Tracks reachable XOR states across bit width b.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all 2^n subsets causes exponential time explosion.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintains an associative lookup table of XOR states.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Converts removal minimization to subset size maximization via XOR states.
